Finding: CWE-22 reported by opengrep rul: Validate that the resolved path stays within the base directory to prevent path traversal.
Prevent path traversal by using `os.path.basename` to extract only the filename component before joining it to the directory path.
Finding: CWE-78 reported by bandit rule: Eliminate the injection vulnerability by passing the filename as an argument to subprocess.run instead of embedding it in a shell command string with shell=True.
Finding: CWE-78 reported by opengrep rul: Replace the f-string with a list of arguments to avoid shell injection when running `du`.
Finding: CWE-79 reported by opengrep rul: Escape the author and text variables before interpolating them into the HTML string to prevent XSS attacks.
Finding: CWE-89 reported by bandit rule: Replace the f-string SQL query with a parameterized query to prevent SQL injection.
Finding: CWE-89 reported by opengrep rul: Replace string formatting in SQL queries with parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection.
Finding: CWE-1333 reported by opengrep r: The regex pattern `^([a-z0-9]+)+$` contains a nested quantifier (`+` inside `+`) which can cause catastrophic backtracking on certain inputs. Changing it to `^[a-z0-9]+$` achieves the same validation (one or more lowercase letters or digits) without the performance issue.
Finding: CWE-209 reported by opengrep ru: Replace the exception repr with a generic message to avoid exposing internal error details.
Finding: CWE-328 reported by bandit rule: Replace MD5 with SHA256 to fix the weak hash vulnerability. MD5 is cryptographically broken and unsuitable for password hashing; SHA256 provides adequate security for this context.
Finding: CWE-502 reported by bandit rule: Replace `pickle` with `json` to safely deserialize untrusted data without the risk of arbitrary code execution.
Finding: CWE-601 reported by opengrep ru: Validate that the returned `next_url` is safe before returning it to prevent open redirect attacks. Only allow URLs that start with "http://" or "https://".
Finding: CWE-918 reported by opengrep ru: Validate the resolved IP address to ensure it is not a loopback, link-local, or private address before fetching.
